The '''rune dagger''' is a [[dagger]] made from [[rune equipment|rune]]. Rune daggers can be made from a single [[rune bar]] at level 85 [[Smithing]]. Each rune dagger created grants 75 experience. Rune daggers are the third-strongest daggers, behind the [[dragon dagger]] and the [[abyssal dagger]]. Like most rune weapons they require 40 [[Attack]] to wield. As with most daggers, this weapon can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]].
